injuries.name: Beaux Collins
injuries.note: Collins (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bengals in Madrid, Spain,, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injuries.name: James Pearce Jr.
injuries.note: The Falcons listed Pearce (back) as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bengals, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injuries.name: Divine Deablo
injuries.note: The Falcons listed Deablo (forearm) as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bengals, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injuries.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
injuries.note: Robinson (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injuries.name: Yasir Abdullah
injuries.note: Abdullah (hamstring) was a limited participant at practice Wednesday.

injuries.name: Samson Ebukam
injuries.note: Ebukam (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve by the Falcons on Tuesday, Tori McElhaney of the team's official website reports.

injuries.name: Zachariah Branch
injuries.note: Coach Kevin Stefanski noted Monday that Branch (hamstring) won't play Sunday against the Bengals, William McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

injuries.name: Cameron Williams
injuries.note: Williams (ankle) will remain on injured reserve and has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, Tori McElhany of the Falcons' official site reports.

injuries.name: Anterio Thompson
injuries.note: Thompson posted on social media this week that he was diagnosed with a genetic mutation on his spinal cord in early May and indicated that he was told he will "never play football again," Josh Kendall of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Cedric Johnson
injuries.note: Johnson (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Falcons in Madrid, Spain.

injuries.name: Kyle Dugger
injuries.note: Dugger (quadriceps) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Falcons in Madrid, Spain.

injuries.name: Cashius Howell
injuries.note: Howell (wrist) was placed on injured reserve by the Bengals on Tuesday.

injuries.name: Andrei Iosivas
injuries.note: Iosivas (thumb) is making good progress in his rehab, Mike Petraglia of CLNSCincy.com reports.

injuries.name: Erick All Jr.
injuries.note: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor confirmed Wednesday that All has been diagnosed with a torn ACL in his right knee and will require season-ending surgery, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.
